RULES.text: Nothing confidential or restricted goes public or into a third-party AI

yn.q: Would I build this if nobody paid?

PURPOSE — 5 WHYS.check: If you can't get past Why 3, there may be no real need underneath.

NON-GOALS.check: Which of my rules does it rely on? (e.g. "no selling")

SUCCESS.check: F4: a number and a date.

STAKEHOLDERS.check: Who outside me is waiting for this?

OWNERSHIP.check: Which named human signs this off?

OPERATIONS.check: Who runs it day to day, and who gets the call when it breaks?

yn.q: Are all running costs (fees, AI calls, hosting) inside the result figures?
yn.msg: Running costs are left out of the numbers.

CONSTRAINTS.check: List what can't change for this project: time, money, rules, hardware, skills.

yn.q: Is anything here confidential or restricted?
yn.msg: Confidential or restricted material: keep this run offline. Never an AI prompt, never a public repo.

yn.q: Does this touch anyone else's money, data or keys?
yn.msg: Touches other people's money, data or keys. That's the job, not a side detail.

DEPENDENCIES.check: Sovereignty: which of these can't I replace or self-host?

check.business: How many customers to reach £X a month?

check.all: Always include "Don't build it / park it" as an option.
check.career: At least one option that isn't a job title, and "don't do it / park it".

DECISION.check: F2: record it in full. F3: one Chosen, not several.
